name: @hamonn/worker
description: hamonn on Cloudflare Workers: Durable Objects + Queues + Artifacts

ARTIFACTS.description: Cloudflare Artifacts namespace that holds the project repos and one fork per lane.

PROJECT.description: One ProjectDO per project: lanes, claims, checks and the serial landing queue (SQLite-backed).

REGISTRY.description: Maps fork repos back to lanes so Artifacts push events reach the right project.

HAMONN_ADMIN_KEY.description: Bearer token required on every write request. Agents and the CLI send it; keep it secret.
